errors.text: The central replacement of thermodynamic integration with free-energy perturbation is absent, so the proposed framework does not reconstruct the main efficiency mechanism of the target method.
The claimed ±50 K accuracy and orders-of-magnitude cost reduction are not supported by the cited evidence.
The proposal does not include electronic free-energy contributions, despite their material effect on the target melting temperature.
Using CALPHAD as the screening baseline is insufficiently qualified where the relevant refractory multicomponent database is extrapolative and uncertain.
